techniques.what: Every frame is a pure function of the integer frame index.
techniques.how: renderFrame(f) only; seeded mulberry32; no wall clock/requestAnimationFrame/Math.random; headless Chrome+SwiftShader; PNG sequence -> H.264 yuv420p -an.
techniques.evidence: Two renders gave identical SHA-256 for 12/12 sampled frames; full MP4 hash stable across the refactor.

techniques.what: Scene beats are anchored to caption cue windows, never to hard-coded frame numbers.
techniques.how: buildTimeline(PKG) -> CUEF/cue(sid,i); visuals may lead words by SYNC_LEAD = round(0.3*fps); QC uses the same windows [cue start-0.3 s, cue end).
techniques.evidence: Caption retiming no longer breaks sync; checklist v2 + caption_sync_evidence.

techniques.what: One integer-frame master timeline; shots contiguous; cues inside shots; chapters are a view of the same timeline.
techniques.how: intelligence/visual_workflow.canonical_timeline + plan_chapters/verify_chapters (partition check, no second clock).
techniques.evidence: Gap/overlap mutations raise ValueError.

techniques.what: One style frame per caption cue from the SAME engine, with a contact sheet bound to the package digest and scene hashes, before the full render.
techniques.how: render_phase02a_visual.py --prototype --preview.
techniques.evidence: 8 style frames for 8 cues.

techniques.what: Whole-video animatic (every 3rd frame, 10 fps) and per-shot motion preview use the production scene, not a separate mock.
techniques.how: --prototype --animatic / --shot S00N (output outside the repo; behind the execution guard).
techniques.evidence: Per-shot S002 preview rendered (105 frames).

techniques.what: Heat/air/refrigerant flow reads as direction: comet trails with arrow-head sprites oriented along the on-screen path; colour encodes state.
techniques.how: Comets(createCometsClass) with curveOf/colorOf/arrows; red=warm, blue=cool; in-situ colour ramp for phase change.
techniques.evidence: Reviewer first render: 'particles float without flow direction' -> fixed from v2.

techniques.what: Mechanism props are articulated and cutaway-ready (pivoting louver, removable panel, visible coil/fins/blower) instead of boxes.
techniques.how: Reusable factories in engines/web/xdx_core/assets (character_bima.js, indoor_ac.js) with explicit parts returned for animation.
techniques.evidence: Registered in registry/asset_registry.json (procedural_ready, is_placeholder=false).

techniques.what: Keep the horizon level (camera.up = world up); move into an insert with a slow eased orbit (~0.9 s); cut on the action instead of whipping between targets.
techniques.how: look(...) with WORLD_UP; no lerp of the up vector; clean cut to the target when the IR fires, then slow push-in.
techniques.evidence: v4 showed 30-40 degree roll and a whip; fixed in v5; owner accepted pacing.

techniques.what: Render a taller virtual frustum and show its lower 80% (setViewOffset) so subjects sit above the caption band; verify the caption rect against the safe area.
techniques.how: camera.setViewOffset(W, H*1.25, 0, H*0.25, W, H); check_caption_safe_area on measured #capbox rects.
techniques.evidence: 446 frames checked, 0 issues.

techniques.what: Locked character/style colours come from the signed character and style bibles; scenes never hard-code them; missing palette fails closed.
techniques.how: load_package_data injects character_palette; bindCharacterPalette validates #RRGGBB x4.
techniques.evidence: No locked hex in scene.js.

techniques.what: Frame 0 renders only after fonts/textures/models have settled; failures abort.
techniques.how: createAssetLoadBarrier().require(label,promise); settle(); failed() throws.
techniques.evidence: Scene loads under the barrier with identical output.

techniques.what: Re-render only shots whose input hash changed (storyboard entry, cues, semantic mappings, global files, assets used by that shot).
techniques.how: render_dependencies.json + shot_input_hashes + plan_selective_rerender. Limit: scene.js choreography is global until beats are split per shot (Phase 02B).
techniques.evidence: Cue edit -> only S003; Bima edit -> S001,S002; global edit -> all.

techniques.what: Fresh-context reviewer scores every shot on 7 dimensions + REF-002 comparison, with actual frame evidence per action and caption window; placeholders/debug overlays are critical.
techniques.how: visual_semantic_qc.build_visual_review_checklist/evaluate_visual_review; shot evidence hash-bound to the render.
techniques.evidence: 4 review rounds drove HARD_FAIL critical defects 21 -> 0.

techniques.what: Final delivery requires: hash/profile match, resolution/fps/frame count on the canonical timeline, no placeholder assets, shot evidence, safe-area report and an independent PASS review.
techniques.how: validate_delivery() / scripts/visual_workflow.py delivery.
techniques.evidence: v5 correctly BLOCKED (no PASS review yet).

techniques.what: Accepted renders become pixel-hash regression benchmarks; refactors must keep them byte-identical.
techniques.how: docs/evidence/phase02a_visual_only/regression_benchmark_v6.json (v5 kept as history).
techniques.evidence: 12/12 identical after moving Bima/AC/comets into modules.

techniques.what: Acting is computed, not guessed: two-bone arm IK puts the wrist on a world target; aimTwo points an object axis at a target with a secondary facing axis; lookHead turns the head with limits.
techniques.how: engines/web/xdx_core/rig_ik.js (solveArm, aimTwo, lookHead, anchor). Hand-held props are built with the handle inside the fist and the functional part beyond it.
techniques.evidence: v7: fan blade faces his face (dot 0.65-0.75), wrist at forehead during the wipe, head and remote tip aimed at the AC (dot 0.97/1.0) before the press.

techniques.what: Every important action is an action event (actor, part, object, target, direction, cue-relative window, ordering) verified from scene probes before pixel review.
techniques.how: projects/<id>/action_events.json + intelligence/action_choreography.py + window.__xdxProbe; scripts/visual_workflow.py verify-actions; delivery gate blocks missing/failed reports.
techniques.evidence: Mutation tests: fan facing away, fan far from face, early head turn -> BLOCKED.

techniques.what: Cause-and-effect order: the preparatory gesture (head turns to the target, tool aimed) happens in the medium shot, then a hard cut to the macro of the contact action (thumb presses), then a cut to the effect.
techniques.how: Hide occluders (head, torso) during the macro so the lens is free; level horizon; no camera move between distant targets.
techniques.evidence: Owner feedback accepted the cutaway order; v7 frames 132-160.

techniques.what: Repeated gestures are driven by the right joint (wrist flexion for fanning) with the prop rigidly parented to it, biased so the functional face keeps pointing at the target across the cycle.
techniques.how: solveArm for the base pose, aimTwo for the prop axes, then wrist.rotateX(bias + amp*sin); verify with rigid + travel_gt + facing constraints in action_events.json.
techniques.evidence: v8: fan travels 3.1 m over the window while rigid to the wrist; facing >= 0.5 on all sampled frames.

techniques.what: Every label is a pill + leader line + small ring on the named part; the pill is offset away from the subject and never covers the caption, another pill or the part.
techniques.how: engines/web/xdx_core/callouts.js (place with an offset in px); authoring aids __xdxScreenToLocal and __xdxPick; intelligence/callout_contract.py verifies layout per sampled frame.
techniques.evidence: v8 callout_verification OK on all label frames; defects found by the checker were fixed (off-frame pill, short leader).

techniques.what: The nominal target duration is a default; shots that need more time to show the action are stretched and every timing field is rewritten consistently.
techniques.how: intelligence/visual_workflow.py retime_package (piecewise-linear frame map on shot boundaries) + min_seconds per action event; scene beats are anchored to caption cues, not frame numbers.
techniques.evidence: AC benchmark 15 s -> 19.5 s (S001 5.5 s, S002 6 s) with one canonical timeline.

techniques.what: Cut-away sets cut floor and wall on the same plane and keep ground continuous in front of the cut; strays (protruding foundation, long shadows) are found by raycast.
techniques.how: __xdxPick(frame, x, y) lists the objects under a pixel; fix by flushing geometry to the cut plane or disabling the caster.
techniques.evidence: v8 S004 ground seam and grey wedge removed.

techniques.what: One shot_spec.json per topic holds each shot's verified action events and callouts; action_events.json is compiled from it and the scene reads labels from it. Choreography lives in shots/S00N.js so one shot edit re-renders one shot.
techniques.how: Author shot_spec.json, run visual_workflow.py apply-spec (validate + compile + suggested durations), then verify-actions; edit only the shot file or spec entry that changed and use rerender-plan.
techniques.evidence: AC benchmark: callouts moved from scene code to spec and scene split per shot with pixel regression unchanged; editing S002.js re-renders only S002.

techniques.what: Design acceptance combines silhouette IoU with row-width volume profile, framing, palette consistency, landmarks, part proportions and geometry integrity; any hard failure fails.
techniques.how: intelligence/design_fidelity_gate.evaluate_design(...) with geometry from geometry_quality.validate_prefix collected inside Blender.
techniques.evidence: Synthetic tests: same-shape/wrong-colour render passes IoU but fails the gate.

techniques.what: Read-only bmesh/BVH QC (non-manifold, loose, zero-area, duplicates, budget, curvature proxy, gap analysis, part proportions) runs in Blender 5.3 on Android aarch64 within the call budget.
techniques.how: engines/blender_scripts/geometry_quality.py via execute_blender_code; filter by object prefix.
techniques.evidence: Device run: 59 Ingpoh objects validated in 0.15 s; tris budget flagged 73.6k then 45.6k after decimation.

techniques.what: Chibi long hair reads correctly as 4 side + 5 back wavy tapered locks (sine offset, flare, flattened depth) plus leaf-shaped bangs, instead of an ellipsoid or 12 thin locks.
techniques.how: Bezier curve + taper object, bevel, flatten Y to 55-60%, decimate 0.5 only on non-print parts, inverted-hull outline; re-check ink material offset after decimate.
techniques.evidence: Front/side/back/perspective/close-up viewport renders compared before/after in the 02B.3 session.
